scripts.build: npm run check && npm test && node scripts/build-static.mjs
scripts.check: find api lib scripts tests -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && node --check app.js && node --check analytics.js && node --check catalog.js
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run contracts:test && npm run repo:check
scripts.deploy:production:candidate: node scripts/assert-deploy-target.mjs production && npm run ci && vercel deploy --prod --skip-domain --yes
scripts.deploy:staging: node scripts/assert-deploy-target.mjs staging && npm run ci && node scripts/deploy-staging.mjs
scripts.test: node tests/smoke.mjs && node tests/backend.mjs && node tests/delivery.mjs && node tests/resale.mjs && node tests/resale-seller-actions.mjs && node tests/resale-indexer.mjs && node tests/sponsored-userop.mjs && node tests/owner-exit.mjs && node tests/marketplace-qol.mjs
